provenance_note: Candidate describes its code as derived from touchHLE; original lineage has not been independently reconstructed.
local_changes: Use actual generic GuestMem parameters throughout all instruction decoders.
Remove the candidate default allocator and unsafe Send assertion; memory is owned by the host.
Remove game-specific fast paths, PC guards, debug logging and unavailable differential harness.
Remove tests tied to the missing upstream differential harness; add portable behavior tests separately.
Preserve MPL headers and instruction decoder logic for initial testing; later fixes must have dedicated evidence.
validated_local_fixes: Zero tick budget executes no instruction.
A32 LDREX/STREX byte/halfword/word/doubleword decoding, bounded memory transfers and CLREX.
Track reservation transfer width and clear it on guest context switches.
Distinct unsupported decoder faults with PC/encoding; cannot enter legacy UDF bypass.
A32/Thumb status-register transfers and A32 breakpoint support; unknown T32 system encodings are rejected.
Respect host data null-access policy while preserving instruction-fetch null protection; strict and legacy fixtures covered.
Normalize A32/T32 NEON logic prefixes, decode all eight U/op variants, and reject odd Q register encodings; 768 register/alias comparisons against Dynarmic.
A32 SMMUL/SMMLA/SMMLS, including rounded forms, wrapping accumulation and register aliases; ARM and existing Thumb paths checked against boundary-value oracle and Dynarmic.

A32/T32 NEON VMUL/VMLA/VMLS by scalar for integer16/32 and finite F32 inputs; snapshot aliased scalar/vector sources, distinguish Q bit location, reject invalid sizes and odd Q registers. 3456 independent oracle and Dynarmic samples. NaN/subnormal/exception/rounding completeness is not established.
A32 MLS with wrapping subtraction, preserved status flags and overlapping operands; 1176 ARM/Thumb boundary cases and 512 randomized backend comparisons.

Validate VFP/NEON register-list ranges and forbidden writeback before transfer. Preserve legal A32 PC-relative lists. Eight rejection cases have no data/register side effects; five legal edge cases match Dynarmic. Same 416303-word syntactic corpus changes 84 distinct panic encodings to unsupported faults, with no remaining Rust panic in that corpus.

A32 signed/unsigned byte/halfword/byte-pair extensions and optional accumulated aliases, including four rotations and independent halfword wrapping. 6048 ARM/Thumb edge cases and 9216 randomized full-state Dynarmic comparisons.

A32/T32 vector F32 VMLA/VMLS (non-fused), exact F32 matching, odd Q register rejection and VMIN/VMAX signed-zero rules. 5376 finite input, independent register-bank and alias samples against Dynarmic; NaN, subnormal, exception flags and complete rounding behavior remain unverified.

A32/T32 VDUP scalar for every 8/16/32-bit lane index, D0-D31 sources, D/Q destinations and source overlap with either Q half; invalid widths and odd Q destination rejected. 4032 independent oracle and Dynarmic comparisons.

A32 SMULxy/SMLAxy/SMLALxy/SMULWy/SMLAWy with signed operands, 64-bit wraparound, aliases and sticky Q. Prevent S=0 miscellaneous encodings from being silently treated as TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN. 14112 edge cases and 6144 randomized Dynarmic comparisons.

A32/T32 VLD1-4/VST1-4 single-element structure transfers, 8/16/32-bit lane preservation, register stride, aliases and writeback. 4736 independent-oracle and Dynarmic cases; reserved alignment and register overflow rejected before transfer. Runtime alignment faults and all-lanes group remain unimplemented.
